commentary: August revenue of [[revenue.month.actual]] came in above budget by [[revenue.month.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.month.vs_py]] ([[revenue.month.vs_py_pct]]), driving operating profit of [[operating_profit.month.actual]], well above budget by [[operating_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[operating_profit.month.vs_py]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_py_pct]]). Marlow & Finch billed [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.actual]] in August, below its May to July average by [[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m]] ([[client.marlow-finch.revenue.month.vs_avg3m_pct]]), and its share of year-to-date agency revenue stands at [[client.marlow-finch.share.ytd.actual]] against [[client.marlow-finch.share.month.actual]] for August alone, which the owner may wish to review.
